newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end higher on GDR-related scrips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end higher on GDR-related scrips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed higher on Thursday on buying of GDR-related scrips by foreign buyers that prompted local investors to make big investments, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 19.80 points, or 1.38 percent, higher at 1,452.72 amid 130 gainers and 77 losers. Turnover rose to 29 million shares compared to Wednesday's 28 million.
The rise in GDR-linked scrips of PTCL ad HUBCO dominated the sentiment, one dealer said. This rally was likely to continue for one or two sessions and a technical correction was now due.
